headline: CP Capital Limited announces Annual General Meeting voting results
hook: AGM voting results filed by CP Capital
summary: CP Capital Limited has submitted the official voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing details the outcome of shareholder resolutions presented during the meeting. Routine corporate governance filings of this nature have negligible impact on retail trading volumes. Indian retail investors tracking micro-cap filings will find this purely procedural.
why_it_matters: Purely procedural corporate filing with zero impact on stock price.
